blurb: Centralia Balloon Fest is a community event held annually starting the 3rd Friday of August. Guests can experience hot air balloons inflating and flying, enjoy live entertainment, kids' activities, and local vendors. Balloon flights occur in the early morning and evening, weather permitting, with balloon setups close to attendees.
